name: Information Security Regulation 2026
desc: Sets the minimum information security controls for supervised organisations: governance, asset management, access control, operations and incident response. Organisations answer each requirement once a year and attach evidence; an accredited assessor confirms the outcome.

reqs.text: The organisation shall maintain an information security policy approved by its board and reviewed at least once a year.
reqs.guidance: Upload the policy and the board resolution that approved the current version. If the review is overdue, say when it is scheduled.
questions: Does the board approve the information security policy?
When did the board last review the policy?
Who owns the policy day to day?

reqs.text: The organisation shall appoint a chief information security officer who reports to executive management.
reqs.guidance: Give the name and reporting line. If the role is outsourced, describe the arrangement.
questions: Has a chief information security officer been appointed?
To whom does the CISO report?

reqs.text: The organisation shall carry out an information security risk assessment at least once a year and after any major change.
reqs.guidance: Summarise the method used and the top risks identified.
questions: Was a risk assessment completed in the last 12 months?

reqs.text: Keep an up-to-date inventory of critical information assets, with a named owner for each.
reqs.guidance: Upload the inventory or an extract showing critical assets and owners.
questions: Is there a current inventory of critical assets?
How many critical assets are listed?

reqs.text: All privileged and remote access to production systems shall require multi-factor authentication.
reqs.guidance: Explain how MFA is enforced for administrators and remote users. Include any exceptions and how they are approved.
questions: Is MFA enforced for all privileged access?
Is MFA enforced for all remote access?

reqs.text: Access rights to critical systems shall be reviewed at least quarterly and unused accounts removed within 30 days.
reqs.guidance: Attach the last two signed access reviews.
evidence: Signed access review reports for the last two quarters
questions: Are access rights reviewed every quarter?

reqs.text: Major security incidents shall be reported to the regulator within 24 hours of detection.
reqs.guidance: Describe how incidents are classified and who reports them.
questions: Is there a documented incident response plan?
How many major incidents were reported in the period?

reqs.t: Test the incident response plan yearly
reqs.text: The incident response plan shall be tested at least once a year through a tabletop or live exercise.
reqs.guidance: Attach the exercise report and the actions that came out of it.
questions: Was the plan tested in the last 12 months?

name: Data Protection Compliance Framework
desc: How organisations that process personal data show lawful processing, records of processing, data subject rights and breach handling.

reqs.text: Maintain a current record of processing activities covering purpose, lawful basis and retention.
reqs.guidance: An extract is enough if the full record is long.
questions: Is the record of processing activities current?

reqs.text: Each processing purpose shall have a documented lawful basis.
questions: Is a lawful basis recorded for every purpose?

reqs.t: Notify personal data breaches within 72 hours
reqs.text: Notify the authority of personal data breaches within 72 hours of becoming aware of them.
questions: Is there a breach notification procedure?

name: Consumer Protection Rules
desc: Fair treatment of customers of digital financial services: complaints, disclosure and redress.

reqs.text: Customer complaints shall be acknowledged within 48 hours and resolved within 14 days.
reqs.guidance: Give average resolution time for the period.

name: Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines
desc: Risk-based customer due diligence, monitoring and reporting of suspicious transactions. Draft for consultation.

reqs.text: Apply customer due diligence measures proportionate to the assessed money-laundering risk.
questions: Is CDD applied on a risk basis?
